message: 暴虐ウェイトレスＶＳ恐怖の司書

name: Pasta
message: 「It's started, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Soltia said enemies would appear if I activated the magic circle, but... can I really count on that, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「If I don't show my good side soon... Bylous-nyama will hate me, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「I know that without him telling me, nya...」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Nyaa!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Things are about to start here too, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaaaaaaa! Nyaaaaaaaa!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Guh, kuah, kuuuuuh.」

name: Pasta
message: 「F-Forcing my magic power up is... t-tough, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Huff, huff... Come... Come out already, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Though... if they don't come, they don't come... I'll just keep doing my part-time job, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Something's coming, nyan.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya? I-It's the librarian, nya!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nnyanyaaa!? If a staff member sees me wandering around at night, I'll get fired from my waitress job, nya!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good evening, Pasta-san.」

name: Pasta
message: 「G-Good evening, nya. Nyahahaha. U-Um, I just got a little lost, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so? That must be quite troublesome.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Y-Yes it is, nya! Super troublesome, nya! But you have it rough too, Ms. Librarian, nya! Wandering around even at night carrying such a thick, triple-sleep-inducing book, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is my job, after all.」

name: Pasta
message: 「U-Um, which way is Prier, nya? If you tell me, I'll go there myself, nya.」
Melilot gave a small smile and opened the thick book she was holding. An eyeball spread across the entire page glared sharply at Pasta.

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaaah!? An Artifact Creature!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Crunch.」
Before Pasta could scramble backward, the one-eyed monster that leaped from the open pages unhinged its massive jaws and tried to swallow the prey before it whole!

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Nyaa!」
The lowly demons bravely stepped in to block its path, only to be swallowed in an instant.

name: Pasta
message: 「Y-You guys, no, nyaaa!」
Crushed inside the enormous maw, they flashed with light for a single second before their existence was wiped from the Human World.

name: Pasta
message: 「You little nya-stard!」
Torn apart by Pasta's sharp claws, the monster exploded.
It immediately turned into several burning scraps of paper that fluttered into the night sky.

name: Pasta
message: 「You... Could you be Nive?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Swallow him.」
Monsters poured forth from the open pages once again, lunging at Pasta one after another.

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-nya-nyaaaah!」
Claws glinted, and with every flash, the emerging monsters were shredded apart, turning into a few burning scraps of paper before fleetingly vanishing.

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaa! Shut up already, nyaaa!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Huff, huff... Next, it's my turn, nya!」
Melilot silently opened the book.
One-eyed, two-eyed, three-eyed, winged, jet-black, four-legged, and centipede-like monstrosities writhed inside the book, on the verge of spilling out.

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya, nya, time-out, nya!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please return to the Demon World.」
Among the trees surrounding the two, the presence of countless demonic creatures writhed.
Though there was no wind, the treetops swayed, filling the air with a rustling murmur.

name: Pasta
message: 「You're the one going back to the Demon World, you damn witch! The guys hiding all over the academy have gathered right here, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「They certainly have gathered.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even if you really are the legendary witch Nive, you can't block this many of my allies attacking all at once, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Everyone, tear this witch to shreds, nya!」
The presences surrounding them showed no reaction whatsoever.

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What's wrong, nya?! Beat her up already, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「No way...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems your subordinates have been taken care of.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Tear apart. Crush flat. Pierce through. Smash to pieces.」
The surrounding presence stirred all at once, moving with an unpleasant aura like stagnant filth.
At the same time, pages fluttered with the night wind. Over a dozen monsters surged forth from the book at once.
The over one hundred monsters all aimed for Pasta alone.

name: Pasta
message: 「Y-you bastaaaard-nya!」
The hooked claws extending from Pasta's paw pads grew even longer. They gleamed pale blue, as if wet with moonlight.
Magic power flowed all the way to the tips of the claws, making them shine platinum.

name: Pasta
message: 「Hiiisssssssss!」
Pasta leaped as if charging straight through the swarming monsters!
With the powerful muscle strength unique to a Demon combined with a temporary boost from enhanced magic, it was truly godlike speed.

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm gonna rip that smug face of yours to shreds, nya!」
The white-hot claws shone like fragments of the sun!
A monster with bat wings and a human face that charged at the forefront was torn cleanly in two, turning into shredded scraps of paper and bursting into flames.

name: Pasta
message: 「So weak, nya!」
However, at the same time, another monster's fangs sank deep into Pasta's body. A torrent of magic battered Pasta's body.

name: Pasta
message: 「This isn't enough to stop me, nyaaa! Get out of my way, nyaaaa!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Weak, weak, weak, so weak, nyaaaaa!」
Pasta pushed back the swarming monsters inch by inch, closing in on Melilot.
As the claws glowed red-hot with magic, the monsters turned into burning scraps of paper one after another, blowing away into the night wind and vanishing.
Yet the monsters did not go down without a fight, biting and tearing into Pasta's body.

name: Pasta
message: 「Ow, ugh, gyaaaaah! Damn it, nya!」
With bloodshot eyes, Pasta glared at Melilot, who watched the struggle with a cool expression.

name: Pasta
message: 「You shitty shut-in witch, enemy of Bylous-nyamaaaaa!」
With over a dozen monsters still clamped onto Pasta's body, Pasta ran.
Burning nearly ten monsters blocking the way in a single strike, Pasta closed the distance to Melilot in an instant.
A split second. A gap opened in the formation of monsters protecting Melilot.
Nothing stood on the line connecting the two.
Pasta flew like a bolt of lightning!

name: Pasta
message: 「Die, nyaaaaaaa!」
The moment the claws of death were raised high.

name: Melilot
message: 「Goodbye.」

name: Voice
message: 「O spirits of flash and passion omnipresent in the sky... dye the world in crimson!」
Just as the grove surrounding the church flashed, five thick beams of light struck the two fighters directly.

name: Pasta
message: 「Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!」
The white light shattered, and a massive pillar of fire shining in seven colors rose from the courtyard into the heavens, scorching the night sky.
Before long, everything returned to the night, leaving only a faintly flickering magic circle as a trace of the anomaly.
Soltia stopped in her tracks.
A charred book lay fallen at her feet. The barely remaining cover was the same as the book Melilot had been holding moments ago.

name: Soltia
message: 「It seems I defeated her... the witch.」
As for Pasta, not even a trace remained.

name: Soltia
message: 「Foolish woman. Still, I'll tell Bylous that victory was achieved through your sacrifice--」
Suddenly, Soltia fell silent.

name: Soltia
message: 「Why... is it so cold?」

name: Voice
message: 「You would do well to hold off on telling him.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good evening. Teacher Sengen'in.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Good evening, Librarian Melilot... or rather, should I call you Nive?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Attacking your own ally as well is hardly graceful.」

name: Soltia
message: 「She wasn't an ally. Our paths just happened to align up to this point.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then let us consider your path ended here as well, and I shall let you finish your journey together.」
As Soltia inched backward to put distance between them.

name: Soltia
message: 「How... did you escape?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I merely used the Artifact Creature as a shield and slipped in a dummy of myself while I was at it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Surely you are capable of the same, are you not?」

name: Soltia
message: 「...Of course.」
Soltia asked while backing away little by little.
Having just unleashed a massive offensive spell, Soltia's magical power was temporarily depleted.

name: Soltia
message: 「You lost your book, and yet... why have you shown yourself?」
However, Melilot's magic should have been just as depleted.
After all, the magic circle currently active was under Soltia's control, preventing the magical energy on the academy grounds from flowing into Melilot.
Wasn't it precisely because Melilot realized this that she had prepared such a massive number of Artifact Creatures capable of operating on meager amounts of magic?

name: Melilot
message: 「I never expected to defeat you with a parlor trick of that level.」
The battlefield itself was supposed to guarantee Soltia's overwhelming advantage.
Therefore, now that the book producing the Artifact Creatures was lost, the match was decided.
And yet, why wasn't she retreating.

name: Soltia
message: 「To receive such praise from a 'Witch,' I'm honored--」
Soltia's words froze mid-sentence.
What the biting chill in the air signified, despite the activation of a spell that generated immense heat, was.

name: Melilot
message: 「You already know the reason I've shown myself, don't you?」
It meant that the witch standing before her had absorbed the massive volume of magical energy itself before that immense heat could even be generated.
The book was merely a prop to make her believe Melilot had given up on fighting with magic.
Soltia had been played while thinking she was the one setting the trap.

name: Soltia
message: 「But... there's no absorption magic circle anywhere--」
Soltia gasped, speechless.
There had been the perfect medium on which to draw a magic circle.
The book.
Melilot had drawn it in the book, brought it in, and activated it.

name: Melilot
message: 「I am the hunter, and you are the prey.」
Soltia, whose magic was depleted, even if only temporarily, and Melilot, who had just acquired a massive amount of magic.
Which of them held the overwhelming advantage was obvious.

name: Soltia
message: 「...I am the decoy meant to bring down the legendary witch.」
Soltia, who had been steadily backing away, touched the outer edge of the magic circle with her foot.
A massive surge of magical energy came flowing in from the circle under her control.

name: Soltia
message: 「With your magic depleted, Bylous will--」
Buy thirty seconds.
With thirty seconds, she could store up enough magic to escape.

name: Melilot
message: 「Stalling for time until your magic recovers, are you?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Why don't you test whether I'm just stalling?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will gladly let you buy as much time as I require.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Wh... What do you mean...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That should be quite enough.」
Melilot put her hand in her pocket, as if about to pull something out--

name: Synn
message: 「Over here!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm sleepy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Making a racket this late at night--have a little consideration for other people!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the enemy of good skin. Hmph.」

name: Shio
message: 「And yet I told you to leave the vanguard to me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, be careful! That magical presence was huge, like a giant wave.」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be a Demon General?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did that guy Bylous show up...?」

name: Soltia
message: 「We have company.」

name: Melilot
message: 「So it seems.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn! Don't run ahead by yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nobody's here...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though magical powers were clashing so flashily just now!? Look closer!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, Jiiya. Huh... no way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong, Lolo?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He says there are no unidentified presences within the academy.」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But just a moment ago.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...It's magic.」

name: Synn
message: 「Magic?」

name: Shio
message: 「The bewitching arts used by heretics! How filthy.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll listen to your lecture later, Shio, so just be quiet for now.」

name: Ria
message: 「When you say magic... you mean the power used by Demons, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, yeah. This is some seriously high-level stuff, though. It makes both their presence and existence completely undetectable.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you're saying guys like that were fighting right here?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks that way.」

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「I found this lying over there, but what do you think it is?」

name: Misa
message: 「It looks like the cover of a book.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll try showing it to Melilot tomorrow. Maybe she'll know something.」
